# ts-ioc-container

> TypeScript dependency injection container: scoped lifecycles, decorators (`@register`, `@inject`, `@hook`), typed tokens, lazy dependencies, provider pipes. Plus React bindings in `@ts-ioc-container/react`, the `tic` build-time bundler in `@ts-ioc-container/bundler`, and OpenAPI code generators plus Express glue in `@ts-ioc-container/openapi-to-server`, `@ts-ioc-container/openapi-to-zod` and `@ts-ioc-container/openapi-express-server`. The API changes between majors: prefer the `AGENTS.md` shipped in the installed package (`node_modules/ts-ioc-container/AGENTS.md`) over memory.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md (core)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/AGENTS.md): setup, recipes, pitfalls, removed APIs, error codes
- [README (core)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/ts-ioc-container/README.md): full documentation with executable examples
- [AGENTS.md (react)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/react/AGENTS.md): React bindings
- [AGENTS.md (bundler)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/bundler/AGENTS.md): `tic build` — bundles your dependencies into a single container module, from folders / tsconfig aliases
- [AGENTS.md (openapi-to-server)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/openapi-to-server/AGENTS.md): OpenAPI 3 → TypeScript types, one `<Op>HttpRoute` per operation, `IServer`, Axios `ApiClient`
- [AGENTS.md (openapi-to-zod)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/openapi-to-zod/AGENTS.md): OpenAPI 3 → Zod schemas and a `PAYLOADS` request-validator map
- [AGENTS.md (openapi-express-server)](https://github.com/IgorBabkin/ts-ioc-container/blob/main/packages/openapi-express-server/AGENTS.md): Express routing for the generated interfaces, with a ts-ioc-container request scope
